core_obligations: Describe the contraction (proof lines 4548-4566): the contraction is proper and surjective, hence submersive, so the underlying topological space of the target is the quotient identifying all points of the curve; the structure sheaf of the target maps isomorphically to the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the source, since this is clear away from the image point and holds at that point by the computation of the cohomology of the blowup; hence the contraction is obtained by taking the quotient space and endowing it with the pushforward sheaf.

Produce the factorization on the level of ringed spaces (proof lines 4568-4580): a morphism whose image on the curve is a point factors uniquely through the quotient map of topological spaces, and the pullback map of structure sheaves is adjoint to a map from the structure sheaf of the target of the quotient into the pushforward sheaf, which is the structure sheaf of the contracted scheme; thus one obtains a morphism of ringed spaces factoring the given morphism.

Check the locality of the resulting map (proof lines 4580-4586): since the given morphism is a morphism of locally ringed spaces, it remains to see that the induced map on stalks at the image point is local; an element of the maximal ideal there pulls back to a function on the source vanishing at every point of the curve, so its pullback to the contraction vanishes on a neighbourhood of the image point and in particular at that point, as required.
proof_roadmap: Identify the contraction with the quotient topological space endowed with the pushforward of the structure sheaf.
Construct the factorization of a morphism collapsing the curve on the level of ringed spaces via adjunction.
Verify locality of the map on stalks at the image point using the vanishing of the pulled back functions on the curve.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a contraction of an exceptional curve of the first kind has the universal property that every morphism whose image on the curve is a point factors uniquely through it (statement lines 4538-4546). The proof (proof lines 4548-4599) identifies the contraction with the quotient topological space carrying the pushforward of the structure sheaf, constructs the factorization on the level of ringed spaces, and verifies locality of the resulting map on stalks. H2: a three-step construction with two inputs, written out in full.
